notes.summary: Units = all tumanlar (incl. Tashkent city districts and 2 city-internal districts of Namangan) + cities of regional/republican subordination (SOATO 7-digit codes 17RR4NN). Built by merging two independent public SOATO-coded datasets; Russian/Uzbek-Cyrillic names come from the sources (Latin homoglyphs inside Cyrillic words normalized). No coordinates in either source, so lat/lng are null. Official sites (stat.uz, siat.stat.uz, lex.uz, data.gov.uz, wikipedia) were blocked by the network egress policy and could not be fetched directly; the per-region count of regional-subordination cities was cross-checked against a stat.uz figure (32 cities as of 2023-01-01) seen via web search snippet only.
